fields.FIR_Description: During the afternoon of 2026-03-10, around 15:30, a person allegedly threatened the complainant at Sindhu Colony College Road in Erode and took a wristwatch, according to the complaint recorded on 2026-03-12. Nandhini Selvi reported the matter orally at Erode Central PS; the contact number given was 9000000239. A person named Rajesh Chandran, associated with the number 9000000486, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. A witness, Madhan Murugan, reachable on 9000000216, was mentioned in the complaint. A green motorcycle with registration TN-30-XX-1039 was observed near Sindhu Colony College Road. The complainant mentioned CCTV footage, a vehicle observation and a witness statement.
fields.Evidence_Mentioned: CCTV footage; Vehicle observation; Witness statement
fields.Modus_Operandi: Victim allegedly intercepted and threatened before valuables were taken. A motorcycle was reportedly used to leave the area.
fields.Keywords: robbery, threat, mobile number, afternoon, suspect, vehicle observation, motorcycle, college road
